resources.string: Choose your own Japanese .iso or .gcm image. It is copied into the app\'s private storage, so no storage permission is needed.
Some .iso files are hidden from the system picker. Scan Download to find them, or tap Search in the picker and type the file name.
Choose the Download folder once. Android grants read access only to that folder, and the app remembers it for next time. Files stay where they are; the selected image is copied into the app.

A native Android port built from your own GameCube disc. Touch controls, Bluetooth controllers and foldable screens are supported.

This app contains recompiled game code generated from the disc; it does not include the disc image or any game assets. Use it only with a disc you own.

Rendering: gcn-recomp (OpenGL ES 3.2)
Audio: AX mixer
Frontend: SDL2
UI: Material 3
